# Overview

Prep data to extract from CNA




# Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
```


# Data

```{r}
pair_df = read_csv("../data/fire_alt/FireALTEstimatedPairsBurnedUnburned.csv")
raw_df = read_csv("../data/fire_alt/FireAltEstimatedRawData.csv")
```

# View Data

```{r}
pair_df
raw_df
```

```{r}
( us_ca_cna = raw_df %>% 
  filter(cntryId %in% c("US", "CA")) %>%
  dplyr::select(lastNm, plotId, siteId, year, lat, lon, paired, distur, fireYr) %>%
    distinct(lat, lon, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    mutate(across(c(siteId, plotId), 
                ~ str_remove_all(.x, " "), 
                .names = "{.col}_clean")) %>%
  rename(id1 = siteId_clean, id2 = plotId_clean, long = lon) %>%
  mutate(elev = "") %>%
    dplyr::select(id1, id2, lat, long, elev)
  
)
```
%>%
  rename(id1 = lastNm, id2 = plotId, long = lon) %>%
  mutate(elev = "")
```{r}
write_csv(us_ca_cna, "../outputs/2026-08-07_US_CA_4CNA.csv")
```
